rapport_notes: Calvin is friendly, responsive, and patient throughout; he accommodates customer requests gracefully and maintains a warm, professional tone.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; no obvious violations of silence protocol.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked. Calvin launches into logistics and confirmation details immediately without asking 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no customer concerns were raised during discovery, so no follow-up depth to assess.
evidence_quotes.communication_covered: Calvin says: 'I am going to send a confirmation email so you'll have that in the next couple of minutes' (email confirmation provided).
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Calvin says: 'Anything that's boxed we can definitely move pretty quickly... if there's some of that stuff that probably the stuff that would be best to leave behind for them to kind of move over in the coming time' — implies the customer can save time/cost by pre-packing or pre-selecting items.
evidence_quotes.no_estimate_anchor: No typical range given (e.g., 'a typical 1400 sq ft with 2 movers takes 4–6 hours'). No personalization to the specific move either.
evidence_quotes.no_rate_lock_or_close: Call ends with 'I'll email this over and yeah, have a, have a great rest of your day.' No mention of rate lock, no explicit ask for the booking.

top_strength: Calvin expertly manages logistics and payment options with clarity and flexibility, and builds genuine rapport by listening to the customer's constraints and offering solutions without friction.
coaching_note: This call skips the entire sales framework (no agenda-setting, no differentiators, no estimate anchor, no close)—it's a confirmation call, not a sales call. If future calls are inbound quotes, Calvin must open with quid pro quo and their agenda before jumping to logistics.
